headline: Executive order addresses how federal regulations can lead to criminal charges against people and businesses.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with criminal penalties tied to federal regulations, the rules written by federal agencies rather than laws passed by Congress. It appears aimed at limiting or reviewing when breaking these rules can be treated as a crime. No summary was provided, so the specific steps it requires are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that write and enforce regulations
who_it_affects.how: The order likely directs how these agencies handle rules that carry criminal penalties.

who_it_affects.group: Individuals and businesses covered by federal regulations
who_it_affects.how: They may face changes in whether breaking certain federal rules is treated as a crime.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 9, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the provided material.
